description: This file defines an abstract class `WebserviceEntityOperation` that provides a base for web service operations related to entities in a CRM system. It includes method stubs for operations like create, retrieve, update, delete, and describe, which by default throw exceptions indicating unsupported operations. It also contains utility methods for handling field data types and editability checks.

classes.name: WebserviceEntityOperation
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for defining web service operations on CRM entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and utility functions related to entity fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating create operation is not supported for this entity.

methods.description: Throws an exception indicating retrieve operation is not supported for this entity.

methods.name: getFieldTypeDetails
methods.description: Provides details about a web service field, such as picklist values, reference list, max upload size, and date format.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Determines if a web service field is editable based on its properties.

methods.name: getIdField
